A mountain/peak tracking app for mountaineers and hikers to catalog mountains worldwide and log their summit achievements.

## **Summit Tracker**

**App Name:** Summit Tracker
**Slug:** summit-tracker

### Purpose
A mountain/peak tracking app for mountaineers and hikers to catalog mountains worldwide and log their summit achievements.

### Features
1. **Peaks List (Mountains Tab)** — Browse a comprehensive database of mountains with search, category filters (7 Summits, 8000m, 14ers, Alps, Andes, Himalaya, World Classics, My Peaks), sorting (by name/elevation), and unit toggle (meters/feet)
2. **Mountain Detail** — Detailed view for each mountain (`mountain/[id]`)
3. **Map Tab** — Interactive map showing all peaks with markers (green=summited, red=unclimbed), using `react-native-maps` with web fallback
4. **Profile Tab** — Dashboard with summit stats (count, elevation gained, countries, ranges), overall progress, category progress bars, difficulty breakdown, recent summits, highest summit, PDF export, and share functionality
5. **Summit Report** — Modal to log/record summit achievements
6. **O₂ Equivalent** — Modal with oxygen equivalent calculations
7. **Add Mountain** — Modal to add custom peaks
8. **Auth & Cloud Sync** — Sign-in via Supabase, cloud sync for backup, sign out
9. **Custom Mountains** — Users can add their own peaks to the database

### Architecture
- **3 tabs:** Peaks, Map, Profile (each with inner stack layout)
- **Modals:** Summit Report, O₂ Equivalent, Add Peak, Auth
- **State Management:** React Query + custom context providers (SummitContext, CustomMountainsContext, AuthContext)
- **Data:** ~70+ mountains across 8 categories (7 Summits, 8000m peaks, Colorado 14ers, Alps, Andes, Himalaya, World Classics, Custom)
- **Backend:** Supabase for auth and cloud sync

### Key Files
| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `app/_layout.tsx` | Root layout with providers |
| `app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx` | Tab navigation (Peaks, Map, Profile) |
| `app/(tabs)/(mountains)/index.tsx` | Mountains list screen |
| `app/(tabs)/map/index.tsx` | Map screen |
| `app/(tabs)/profile/index.tsx` | Profile/stats screen |
| `app/mountain/[id].tsx` | Mountain detail |
| `app/summit-report.tsx` | Summit logging modal |
| `app/o2-equivalent.tsx` | O₂ calculator modal |
| `app/add-mountain.tsx` | Add custom peak modal |
| `app/auth.tsx` | Authentication modal |
| `constants/mountains.ts` | Mountain data + types |
| `constants/colors.ts` | Color theme |
| `contexts/SummitContext.tsx` | Summit records state |
| `contexts/CustomMountainsContext.tsx` | Custom mountains state |
| `contexts/AuthContext.tsx` | Auth + cloud sync state |
| `components/MountainCard.tsx` | Mountain list item component |
| `components/MountainIcon.tsx` | Mountain icon component |
| `hooks/useAllMountains.ts` | Combines built-in + custom mountains |
| `lib/supabase.ts` | Supabase client |
| `lib/cloudSync.ts` | Cloud sync logic |

metadata.description:
Every peak deserves to be remembered. Summit Tracker is the complete tool for mountaineers and hikers to catalog their climbs, track their progress, and plan the next summit.

BUILT FOR PEAK BAGGERS

Browse 70+ of the world's most iconic mountains across eight curated categories — the 7 Summits, 8000m peaks, Colorado 14ers, the Alps, Andes, Himalaya, and more. Whether you're chasing your first 14er or closing in on a coveted list, every mountain is organized and ready.

LOG EVERY SUMMIT

Record what matters. Each summit report captures the date, conditions, and your personal notes so every achievement is preserved in detail. A lifetime of climbing, distilled into a record that's yours forever.

SEE YOUR WORLD ON THE MAP

An interactive map displays every peak in your database with color-coded markers that separate your summited mountains from the ones still on your list. One glance tells the whole story of where your journey stands.

TRACK THE STATS THAT MATTER

Your profile dashboard surfaces the numbers that count — total summits, cumulative elevation gained, countries visited, and completion percentages across every category. Difficulty breakdowns and progress bars show exactly how far you've come and how much further you can go.

YOUR MOUNTAINS, YOUR LIST

The best peaks on your list don't always appear in a curated database. Add any custom mountain to build a personal peak library that reflects your exact goals,  local summits, obscure routes, or a private challenge only you know about.

HIGH-ALTITUDE READY

An integrated O2 equivalent calculator helps serious mountaineers understand the physiological demands at elevation. One more tool for intelligent preparation before a high-altitude objective.

SAFE IN THE CLOUD

Cloud sync and account backup mean your summit logs travel with you and are never at risk of loss. Switch devices, reinstall, start fresh your record is always waiting.

Every climber has a list. Start building yours. Download Summit Tracker and log your first peak.
